items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins injured his hamstring at Wednesday’s practice, met with doctors; they don’t believe it’s serious but his status for Sunday vs. Bengals is in jeopardy. Levitan notes prior 2024 5-game hammy miss and Week 1 route dominance (37 routes on 42 dropbacks).
items.why: Hamstring injury mid-practice; MRI pending; history of soft-tissue issues.
items.implication: Likely miss Week 2; monitor Thursday/Friday practice.
items.opportunity: Targets/routes to Kayshon Boutte, Xavier Hutchinson, Jaylin Noel, Dalton Schultz.

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) DNP Wednesday; day-to-day per coach after early exit Week 1 (5-150-1). Status uncertain Week 2 vs NO.
items.implication: Jeopardy for Week 2; high upside if active.

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) was a full participant in Wednesday practice, indication he could return Sunday.
items.implication: Likely return boosts NE backfield; reverse any handcuff priority.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey did not practice Wednesday due to a hamstring injury.
items.opportunity: Potential snaps to other DEN RBs if limited/out.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow dealing with back tightness, did not practice Wednesday; got mental reps and expects to play Sunday vs. Texans.
items.why: Back tightness; self-reported expects to play if no surgery needed.
items.implication: Monitor practice progression; high likelihood active.

items.text: Deebo Samuel is a top Week 2 waiver wire target (FFHH); ETR lists as primary beneficiary of Stribling long-term absence alongside Demarcus Robinson.
items.why: Stribling surgery opens SF WR opportunity; prior production.
items.implication: Priority add for immediate and ROS upside.

items.text: 49ers WR De’Zhaun Stribling underwent surgery on ankle/deltoid; out close to 10 weeks or late Nov/early Dec. ETR flags Deebo Samuel (and Demarcus Robinson) as primary waiver beneficiaries.
items.why: Ankle deltoid repair for full recovery.
items.opportunity: Deebo Samuel role expansion as top waiver.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) DNP Wednesday after Week 1 hit; status TBD. ETR waiver beneficiary Tre’ Harris.
Kenneth Walker true workhorse in Chiefs debut: 29 of first 32 RB opps, 19 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks, tied team-high 6 targets (22% share); 23-173-1 rush + 3-18-1 rec. Berry: full-grown-man love.
items.why: Dominant opportunity share as expected in KC.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty tied Bijan for No.1 RB Utilization Score (99) Week 1: 73% snaps, 70% rushes, 61% routes, 21% targets, 23 carries +6 targets, 156 scrimmage yds +2 TDs. Upgrades to high-end RB1 every-down player (Fantasy Life Utilization endorsed by Berry).
items.why: Dominant multi-phase share + efficiency gains vs prior year.

items.text: 49ers TE Jake Tonges out for the season after surgery for torn MCL; placed on IR.
items.implication: SF TE depth thinned; Kittle primary.

items.text: Jameson Williams had the 8th-most expected fantasy points at WR in Week 1 but played a horrific game; xFP based on actual targets/location/depth, not projections.
items.why: High opportunity quality unmet by production.

items.text: Ravens placing WR Ja’Kobi Lane on IR after wrist surgery; out four games.
items.implication: Ravens WR depth hit; Bateman/Moore upside.

items.text: Travis Hunter played only four specialized offensive snaps Week 1 (jet, screens, decoy); never ran route past LOS. Jags intention clear given Meyers extension, BTJ interest, Washington deal status—long season but role limited early.
items.why: Package player only; team actions confirm limited offensive plan.
